Select approved drugs with max_phase = 4. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno. Filter for non-null EFO identifier and non-null EFO indication label. Join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return distinct rows for chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie (EFO identifier), indication_label (EFO term), and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind.
